The creature returns to life with 10d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points and two levels of exhaustion, and any poison or nonmagical disease afflicting it at death is neutralised. This spell does not restore missing body parts, lift a curse, or remove a condition that caused the death; if the body cannot survive, the creature may die again. The black pearl is consumed. A creature returned by reverse death cannot be targeted by it again for 30 days. Unlike divine resurrection, this working leaves a detectable necromantic scar on the soul until the creature next dies.
